title: window.open(..., "_blank") omits noopener — reverse tabnabbing
description: handleSubmit opens the compare/PR URL with window.open(result.compare_url, "_blank") but does not pass "noopener,noreferrer". The newly opened tab receives a live window.opener reference and can navigate the originating app tab (reverse tabnabbing) and read the referrer. This is the only window.open in the frontend so there is no shared safe helper establishing a pattern; the two-arg form is the unguarded default.
evidence: Line 137-141: `const result = await gitSubmit(); if (result.compare_url) { window.open(result.compare_url, "_blank") }`. No third feature-string argument, so window.opener is non-null in the opened tab. compare_url is built backend-side from the remote origin (src/haute/_git.py:284 _build_compare_url) for github/gitlab/azure/bitbucket; a malicious or compromised remote URL would be opened with opener access. Fix: window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer") or set the returned handle's .opener = null.
